entities.summary: Sanyutei Encho I , born Jirokichi Izubuchi , was a Japanese author and rakugo performer of the late Edo and early Meiji eras. He was the founder and head of the Sanyuu school of rakugo, and is considered a pioneer of the rakugo revival.

entities.summary: Sanyutei Encho I , born Jirokichi Izubuchi , was a Japanese author and rakugo performer of the late Edo and early Meiji eras. He was the founder and head of the Sanyuu school of rakugo, and is considered a pioneer of the rakugo revival.
